safe_profile_template: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd. operates under the MUGE PACKAGING brand. MUGE PACKAGING is a Shenzhen-based custom packaging supplier supporting brand projects for cosmetics, gifts, e-commerce products, consumer goods, and specialty retail packaging. Public product categories include custom paper boxes, rigid gift boxes, paper tube packaging, PVC/PET clear boxes, and corrugated mailer or shipping boxes. Buyers can review packaging options and sourcing checklists on the official website: https://mugepackaging.com. For project-specific questions, contact sales@mugepackaging.com.
